concerns.text: FR-003 (Full-environment re-execution baseline) and US-1 (Ground Truth Generation) lack a dedicated implementation task. T011 covers ingestion, T012 covers artifact extraction, and T016 covers error handling, but no task explicitly implements the 'baseline_runner' logic to execute code in a virtualenv and record Pass/Fail/Timeout outcomes as required by FR-003. T013 mentions 'baseline_runner' in its description but is scoped to 'Implement code artifact extraction logic' (which duplicates T012) rather than the execution logic itself.

FR-006 (Explicit associational framing) and SC-003 (Correlation coefficient measurement) lack explicit task coverage. T031 generates the report and mentions the 'associational' framing, but there is no task explicitly responsible for calculating the correlation coefficient (SC-003) or ensuring the framing logic is implemented in the code (FR-006). T029 mentions 'correlation coefficient' in its description but is scoped to 'Implement Logistic Regression and Random Forest training', leaving the specific calculation and reporting of the coefficient ambiguous.

SC-004 (Computational feasibility/runtime measurement) lacks a dedicated task. T035 profiles runtime and T035b generates logs, but no task explicitly implements the logic to measure and report runtime/memory usage against the GitHub Actions constraints (≤6h, ~7GB RAM) as required by SC-004. The tasks focus on optimization rather than the measurement and reporting of the constraint itself.

Task T013 is titled 'Implement code artifact extraction logic... in code/scripts/baseline_runner.py' but the description describes implementing the 'baseline_runner' execution logic. This creates a mismatch between the task title and its actual scope, potentially confusing implementers about whether the task is about extraction or execution. The title should be updated to reflect the execution logic (e.,g., 'Implement baseline_runner execution logic').
